"""
	Save button onClick - confirm and trigger form save.
	
	Shows confirmation alert. On confirm, triggers saveDataRoot
	message handler on root.
	
	Version: 1.0.0
	
	Args:
		self (Component): Reference to save button component
	
	Returns:
		None: Shows confirmation alert
	
	Changelog:
		2026-07-05 | William | v1.0.0 - Initial version, standardized across all forms
	"""
	
	# Show confirmation alert, triggers saveDataRoot on confirm
	alerts.showAlert(
		state="warning",
		title="Guardar registro",
		message="Esta seguro de que desea guardar?",
		btnTextPrimary="Si",
		btnTextSecondary="No",
		btnActionPrimary="saveDataRoot"
	)

listCustom = [

	from java.lang import String

	"""

	#regCode = result.getValueAt(0,0)

	if result.getRowCount() > 0:

	query = """

		FROM registerhistory
		WHERE WorkstationNodeID=? AND PapoID=?

	"""


	result = system.db.runPrepQuery(query, [workstationNodeID,papoID], "papo_db")
	
	status = result.getValueAt(0,0)

	def insert_answer(registerTypeID, answerJson, regCode):

			return
		query = """
			INSERT INTO registerhistory (
				[Timestamp],
				DataAnswer,
				Status,
				PapoID,
				RegisterTypeID,
				[User],
				WorkstationNodeID,
				NodeID,
				WorkstationID,
				RegisterCode
			)
			VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ? ,?)
		"""
		
		# ⚠️ Aseguramos que sea String plano
		data_answer_str = String(answerJson)
		
		params = [
			now,
			data_answer_str,
			status,
			papoID,
			registerTypeID,
			user,
			workstationNodeID,
			nodeID,
			workstationID,
			regCode
		]
		system.db.runPrepUpdate(query, params, "papo_db")
	
	# --- Insertar directo los tres JSON ---
	insert_answer(3, system.util.jsonEncode(answer30min), regCode)  # 30 minutos
	insert_answer(1, system.util.jsonEncode(answer1hour), regCode)  # 1 hora
	
	self.view.params.lastRegisterType = 4
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshTable",   {"estado": True},  scope="session")

	system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshPeriodic",{"min": 0},        scope="session")
	system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshPreviewTable", payload=[], scope="session")

customMethods.script:
"""
	Toggle accordion sections in form view.
	
	Expands the clicked FlexContainerGroup and collapses all others.
	Finds all FlexContainerGroups and Sections by name scanning root
	children, independent of component hierarchy.
	
	Version: 2.0.0
	
	Args:
		sectionIndex (int): Section number clicked (1-based)
	
	Returns:
		None: Modifies component display and styles directly
	
	Changelog:
		2026-07-05 | William | v1.0.0 - Initial version
		2026-07-05 | William | v2.0.0 - Dynamic hierarchy-independent approach
	"""
	
	STYLE_ACTIVE = "button-questions"
	STYLE_INACTIVE = "button-questions-2"
	
	thisSectionIndex = int(sectionIndex)
	
	# Scan root children to find all FlexContainerGroups and Sections
	root = self
	groups = {}
	sections = {}
	
	for child in root.getChildren():
		childName = child.meta.name
		if childName.startswith("FlexContainerGroup"):
			try:
				idx = int(childName.replace("FlexContainerGroup", ""))
				groups[idx] = child
			except Exception:
				pass
		elif childName.startswith("Section"):
			try:
				idx = int(childName.replace("Section", ""))
				sections[idx] = child
			except Exception:
				pass
	
	# Toggle each group based on clicked section
	for idx, group in groups.items():
		# Store initial basis height on first run
		if not group.custom.get("baseBasisPx", None):
			basisPx = int(str(group.position.basis).replace("px", "")) if group.position.basis else 100
			group.custom.baseBasisPx = basisPx
	
		groupBasePx = int(group.custom.get("baseBasisPx", 0))
	
		if idx == thisSectionIndex:
			# Toggle the clicked group
			currentDisplay = bool(group.position.display)
			newDisplay = not currentDisplay
			group.position.display = newDisplay
	
			# Adjust basis based on visibility
			if newDisplay:
				group.position.basis = str(groupBasePx) + "px"
			else:
				group.position.basis = "0px"
		else:
			# Hide all other groups
			group.position.display = False
			group.position.basis = "0px"
	
	# Update section button styles
	for idx, section in sections.items():
		if idx == thisSectionIndex and groups.get(idx) and bool(groups[idx].position.display):
			section.props.style.classes = STYLE_ACTIVE
		else:
			section.props.style.classes = STYLE_INACTIVE

messageHandlers.script:
"""
	Save form data to registerhistory.
	
	Collects answers from ALL FlexContainerGroups into a single JSON,
	appends supervisor answer and metadata, then performs a single INSERT.
	Works for both Form_start and Form_end variants.
	
	Version: 2.0.0
	
	Args:
		self (Component): Reference to root component
		payload (dict): Message payload (unused)
	
	Returns:
		None: Performs database INSERT and sends UI refresh messages
	
	Changelog:
		2026-07-05 | William | v1.0.0 - Initial version, standardized across all forms
		2026-07-05 | William | v1.1.0 - Unified start/end, dynamic FlexContainerGroup count
		2026-07-05 | William | v2.0.0 - Single INSERT with all groups combined
	"""
	
	logger = system.util.getLogger("papo/forms/saveDataRoot")
	
	try:
		from java.lang import String
	
		# Input variables
		dbConnection = self.view.custom.dbConnection
		papoID = self.view.params.papoID
		userName = self.session.props.auth.user.userName
		firstName = self.session.props.auth.user.get("firstName", "")
		lastName = self.session.props.auth.user.get("lastName", "")
		user = "{} {}".format(firstName, lastName).strip() if firstName or lastName else userName
		workstationNodeID = self.view.params.workstationnodeID
		workstationID = self.view.params.workstationID
		nodeID = self.view.params.nodeID
		status = "En proceso"
		now = system.date.now()
	
		# Count FlexContainerGroups dynamically
		flexGroupCount = 0
		for child in self.getChildren():
			if child.meta.name.startswith("FlexContainerGroup") and child.meta.name != "FlexContainerSupervisor":
				flexGroupCount += 1
	
		# Get last RegisterCode (reuse current cycle)
		queryLastCode = """
			SELECT TOP 1 RegisterCode
			FROM registerhistory
			WHERE WorkstationNodeID = ? AND PapoID = ?
			ORDER BY ID DESC
		"""
		rs = system.db.runPrepQuery(queryLastCode, [workstationNodeID, papoID], dbConnection)
		lastCode = rs.getValueAt(0, 0) if rs.getRowCount() > 0 else 0
		regCode = int(lastCode) if lastCode is not None else 0
	
		# Collect ALL items from ALL groups into one list
		allItems = []
	
		for groupIndex in range(1, flexGroupCount + 1):
			flexGroup = self.getChild("FlexContainerGroup{}".format(groupIndex))
	
			# Collect answers from this group
			answersObj = self.answerRecopile(flexGroup)
	
			# Skip if empty
			items = answersObj.get("items", []) if answersObj else []
			if not items:
				continue
	
			# Clean items - keep only actual answers with papoItemID
			for item in items:
				if isinstance(item, dict) and "papoItemID" in item:
					allItems.append(item)
	
		# Skip save if no answers collected
		if not allItems:
			return
	
		# Append supervisor answer
		supervisorContainer = self.getChild("FlexContainerSupervisor")
		if supervisorContainer is not None:
			supervisorAnswers = self.answerRecopile(supervisorContainer)
			if supervisorAnswers is not None:
				supervisorItems = supervisorAnswers.get("items", [])
				if supervisorItems:
					allItems.append(dict(supervisorItems[0]))
	
		# Get registerTypeID from view custom
		registerTypeID = int(self.view.custom.registerTypeID)
	
		# Get insights from view custom
		insightText = self.view.custom.insights if hasattr(self.view.custom, "insights") else ""
	
		# Append metadata as last item
		allItems.append({
			"insights": insightText,
			"registerTypeID": registerTypeID,
			"user": user,
			"timestamp": str(now)
		})
	
		# Build final JSON
		answersJson = {"items": allItems}
		dataAnswerStr = String(system.util.jsonEncode(answersJson))
	
		# Single INSERT
		insertSql = """
			INSERT INTO registerhistory (
				[Timestamp],
				DataAnswer,
				Status,
				PapoID,
				RegisterTypeID,
				[User],
				WorkstationNodeID,
				NodeID,
				WorkstationID,
				RegisterCode
			)
			VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
		"""
	
		params = [
			now,
			dataAnswerStr,
			status,
			papoID,
			registerTypeID,
			user,
			workstationNodeID,
			nodeID,
			workstationID,
			regCode
		]
	
		system.db.runPrepUpdate(insertSql, params, dbConnection)
		# logger.info("Record saved - PapoID: {} RegisterCode: {} Items: {}".format(papoID, regCode, len(allItems)))
	
		# UI refresh
		system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshTable", {"estado": True}, scope="session")
		system.perspective.sendMessage("closeEmbeded", {"estado": False}, scope="session")
		system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshPeriodic", {"min": 0}, scope="session")
		system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshPreviewTable", payload=[], scope="session")
	
	except Exception as e:
		logger.error("Error saving form data: " + str(e))
